idea: Represent axis-aligned packings as sequence pairs, which fix for each pair of squares whether one is left of or below the other. For a fixed sequence pair, maximise the sum of sides with an exact LP whose variables are the positions and sides, using linear separation and containment constraints. Search over sequence pairs with simulated annealing, seeded from the best grid-based construction, until the time budget runs out.
